mystical_items.name: Amulet
mystical_items.description: Objects believed to confer protection upon their possessor. Made using Ritualistic Magic with spirituality to carve incantations and symbols on corresponding materials.
characteristics: Do not need an activation incantation
Made for long-term non-combatant passive effects
Must be engraved on both sides with exact symbols and incantations
Strength may be reduced if made incorrectly
Generally filled with mistakes when spread among ordinary populace

mystical_items.name: Beyonder Weapon
mystical_items.description: A fusion of amulet and charm with activation incantation, active-passive effects for long-term usage. Made with ingredients that lose spirituality over time, not with Beyonder Characteristics.
characteristics: Do not have negative downsides like Sealed Artifacts
Can be used until power dissipates
Temporary due to ingredient degradation
Possess activation incantation
Have active-passive effects

mystical_items.name: Charm
mystical_items.description: Mystical items with power bestowed from a high-level existence, contained in a vessel and stabilized by symbols on precious metals.
characteristics: Require specific activation incantations
Cannot be used at will
Physically burn upon completion of activation period
Spirituality decreases over time
Low-grade charms need renewal every two weeks
Vessel uniqueness influences potency
Can be made by praying to one's own name (though weaker)
mystical_items.notes: Eternal Blazing Sun domain charms are most wasteful, burning gold

mystical_items.name: Medicine
mystical_items.description: Extraordinary mixtures made with spiritual ingredients or through Ritualistic Magic for restorative effects.
characteristics: Slowly lose spirituality over time
Generally have expiration dates
Cannot be made with ordinary ingredients for permanent effects
Extraordinary ingredients are very rare
mystical_items.historical_note: From 1352-1358 Fifth Epoch, The Fool Pharmaceutical Company founded by Emlyn White raised importance to medical industry

creation_methods: Beyonders infusing their own pathway power
Using Ritualistic Magic with high spirituality
